summary: A library renovation leaves a local committee with a meeting date and no settled room.
realLife: The Converse County minutes listed two possible Glenrock venues after construction displaced the committee from the library.
inGame: needs: a canceled reservation, the scheduled date and the status of replacement rooms.

turns.what: The secretary sends the new address.
turns.pulledBy: One of the alternate rooms is confirmed.
turns.writesBack: The original date remains on the calendar.

turns.what: The chair tells members the location is still open.
turns.pulledBy: Neither alternate can confirm before notices are due.
turns.writesBack: The notice records a date and a promised update without naming a room.
